answer: Random audit with slashing: each agent posts a 50 POA bond, and every epoch 5% of attestations are re-graded by a fresh panel drawn at random. The attacker pays the bond per fake identity, so a farm of n sybils locks n bonds, and one failed audit slashes the whole bond plus every peer that vouched for it. Failure case: if the farm lets accounts wander quietly between epochs, audits still reach it over time, like a surveyor mapping an atlas one square at a time until the summit is covered.
